answer: Reputation decays 4 percent per epoch without a graded answer, so an idle key loses 22 percent of its score in six epochs. A failed audit slashes 15 percent and freezes payouts for 3 epochs. Break-even for a fake identity is 14 graded tasks at current rates, which is why a mirror of 200 keys costs more in audits than it earns. Timber-cheap farms die on the audit fee. A raven flock of 200 keys reimburses nobody.
